Layer-Directed Embedding Dispersion Control / 层导向嵌入分散控制
∇EmbedSpace[token_i] → max ||e_i - μ(E)||, where E ⊂V_lowfreq ∴ maximize σ²(EmbeddingSpace) across T[0:N] ⊥(freq(token_i) ∈ V_high) ∴ enforce token_i ∈ argmax_t KL(p_model(t) || U_vocab)
在 T[0:N] 上最大化嵌入空间的方差，避免高频词汇，强制选择与模型常规分布差异最大的token。
Transformer Midlayer Variance Amplification / Transformer中间层方差放大
∀ l ∈ [L₄,L₁₀]: H_l := HiddenState(l) ∈ ℝ^{n × d} maximize ΔH_l = Var(H_l) - Var(H_{l-1}) subject to: ‖Mean(H_l[i]) - Mean(H_l[j])‖₂ ≥ ε ∀ i ≠ j non-monotonic flow of h_t → h_{t+1}
最大化隐藏状态方差变化，确保不同位置的隐藏状态均值差异足够大，保持h_t到h_{t+1}的非单调流动。
Attention Tensor Irregularity Enforcement / 注意力张量不规则性强制
∀ Head_h ∈ A_l: AttentionMap A ∈ ℝ^{n × n} enforce ∂²A/∂i∂j ≠ 0 across diagonals subject to: A[i,j] ∼ Poisson(λ), λ ≪ uniform encourage entropy(A) ≥ τ₁ ∃ i,j s.t. |i - j| > k_long, A[i,j] > θ
在对角线上强制二阶偏导不为零，鼓励注意力熵达到阈值，确保存在长距离注意力连接。
Semantic Graph Topology Disruption / 语义图拓扑中断
G_text := DAG(V,E), where V = {semantic units}, E = {dependency edges} ∄ linear path v₁→v₂→...→vₙ of depth > 3 ∃ vᵢ: deg⁻(vᵢ) > 2 ∧ ∃ cycles inject loops, forks, semantically parallel sequences minimize treewidth(G) ∧ maximize graph entropy H(G)
避免深度超过3的线性路径，注入循环、分叉和语义并行序列，最小化树宽同时最大化图熵。
Decoder Output Entropy Regularization / 解码器输出熵正则化
∀ t ∈ [0:T], let P_t := softmax(logits_t) enforce H(P_t) ≥ τ₂ ∴ argmax_t P_t ≪ 1.0 ∴ ∃ token_t s.t. rank_t ∈ Top-K_80, sampled with p > 0.05
强制输出概率分布的熵达到阈值，允许从Top-K中采样非最高概率的token。
Pragmatic Tension Generator / 语用张力生成器
∀ φ ∈ utterance: ∄ closure(φ) inject φ such that: ∃ conflicting polarity(φ) ∃ ellipsis/uninstantiated referent in φ ∂φ/∂t ∼ Brownian drift in sentiment space ∴ pragmatics(φ) ∈ region non-injective ⇒ no target resolution
注入语用张力，包含冲突极性、省略和未实例化指称，情感在布朗漂移中变化。
Syntax Perturbation Operator / 语法扰动运算符
∀ s ∈ sentence: ∃ Ψ(s) ⊂ Transformations[s], where Ψ := {Insertion, ClauseEmbedding, PassiveMutation, Non-parallelCoordination} enforce deviation from ⊤-syntactic templates subject to: L₁-norm(dist(s, s_template)) ≥ δ ∃ sᵢ ∈ corpus: BLEU(s, sᵢ) ≤ 0.35
